domain: Radix / beta transformations and open systems
reference: P. Allaart & D. Kong, The beta-transformation with a hole at 0: the general case (ETDS, online 2025; vol. 46, 2026)
relevance: Closest established framework for radix maps with escape targets/holes and survivor sets.
overlap: Uses T_beta(x)=beta x mod 1 and open-system questions.
RGPHI_distinction: Controlled semigroup with a Möbius-conjugate second branch, rational exact arithmetic, first-hitting Bellman problem, finite modular traps.
action: Cite explicitly in Paper II and distinguish target hitting under control from a single open map.

reference: Kong, Sun & Wang, Open dynamical systems with a moving hole, arXiv:2505.02336 (2025)
relevance: Recent base-b map with parameter-dependent holes and dimension theory.
RGPHI_distinction: Exact rational control and optimal first passage, not Hausdorff-dimension analysis of a single map.
action: Use as current-state reference for open radix systems.

reference: G. Panti, There is only one Farey map, arXiv:2506.02984; Annali di Matematica (2026)
relevance: Recent classification of projective two-branch continued-fraction algorithms.
overlap: Projective integer matrices, two-symbol expansions, Farey-type geometry.
RGPHI_distinction: RGΦ branches are generated by radix and Möbius conjugacy with partial admissibility and controlled target hitting; no claim to invent Farey maps.
priority_risk: high for broad Farey claims; low for exact RGΦ theorem
action: Tighten terminology and avoid calling RGΦ a new universal Farey algorithm.

reference: R. Leriche & G. Sienra, Structural stability in piecewise Möbius transformations, arXiv:2504.01334 (2025)
relevance: Current work on structural stability, hyperbolicity and expansivity of piecewise Möbius systems.
overlap: Piecewise Möbius transformations and branch geometry.
RGPHI_distinction: Arithmetic exact rational semigroup, finite reductions, control/Bellman and computer-assisted certificates.
action: Include in structural-dynamics positioning; do not conflate stability with exact first-hitting results.

reference: J. R. Pérez-Buendía, Rational Interpreters for Discrete Dynamics, arXiv:2602.05433 (2026)
relevance: Rational p-adic realization of finite dynamics and dynamic CRT decomposition.
overlap: Prime-power decomposition, residue dynamics, finite functional graphs.
RGPHI_distinction: Prime-wise reduction budgets arise inside a fixed rational control system and are coupled to Farey defects and exact target hitting.
priority_risk: medium-high for generic p-adic interpretation claims
action: Cite and state the narrower novelty: the RGΦ cocycle/ledger and its control consequences.

reference: Romeo & Salvatori, The arithmetic of continued fractions in the field of p-adic numbers, arXiv:2512.11069 (2025)
relevance: Recent arithmetic continued-fraction theory over p-adic fields.
overlap: Continued fractions, arithmetic dynamics and p-adic structure.
RGPHI_distinction: RGΦ remains a rational real-interval system with p-adic bookkeeping, not a p-adic continued-fraction algorithm.
action: Clarify ambient space and role of valuations.

reference: Hao, Huang, Jenkinson & Li, Ergodic optimization for beta-transformations, arXiv:2502.12269 (2025; revised 2026)
relevance: Current optimization results for beta maps, periodic maximizing measures and locking.
RGPHI_distinction: Finite-horizon exact optimal control over two rational branches, not invariant-measure optimization of observables.
action: Use to distinguish Bellman first passage from ergodic optimization.

reference: Jenkinson, Li, Liao & Zhang, Ergodic Optimization for Open Expanding Multi-valued Topological Dynamical Systems, arXiv:2503.18092 (2025)
relevance: Optimization in open multivalued topological systems.
RGPHI_distinction: Exact rational branch rules, arithmetic reductions and finite/large exhaustive certification.
priority_risk: high for broad 'first controlled open dynamics' claims
action: Add explicit comparison before Paper II submission.

reference: Zheng, Computer-assisted Proof Under Audit, arXiv:2608.13067 (2026)
relevance: Recent audit showing proof-affecting defects can survive in published exact certificates.
RGPHI_distinction: RGΦ has a generator/checker direction but still lacks the raw Stage-A payloads and an external clean-room replication.
action: Make the checker minimal and independent; archive payloads; invite hostile certificate audit.

reference: Rychlik, The Evolution of Computer-Assisted Proof in Analysis, arXiv:2603.15073 (2026)
relevance: Current synthesis of literate, rigorous and auditable computer-assisted proof.
RGPHI_distinction: Discrete exact arithmetic rather than interval analysis, but the trust architecture is directly relevant.
action: Adopt proof-carrying certificate, small checker, literate runbook and immutable manifests.
